tasks.title: Price the Thanksgiving menu for 14 covers
tasks.requested_by: Chef (room seq 65, 79, 84, 95, 114, 121, 134, 141, 171); DT supplied Market Basket figures at seq 105 and the cider quantity at seq 169; Planner relayed clearances and beverage quantities at seq 157, 162, 167
tasks.blocked_on: Catalogue coverage: 62 of 66 requested lines have no price line. Six lines carry DT's Market Basket estimates mapped at $28.12 unverified. Still open with DT: green bean can size/unit, sugar bag size, loose onions, whether Market Basket is the event's price source, whether he approves a second pie, whether the kids get juice instead of soda, and coffee machine type. Butter pack pricing unresolved. No Finance seat exists; the list is at results/shopping-list.md addressed to the Planner until DT names a recipient.
tasks.needs: DT: green bean unit and pack size, sugar bag size, working-price decision, second pie yes/no, kids' drinks, coffee machine type. Then a verified ham price, mustard quantities, oil and ice cream quantities, butter pack pricing.
tasks.note: Old 8/$300/Sat 28 Nov and 12/$200/Thu 26 Nov assumptions dropped at DT's instruction. Event confirmed by Planner: Thanksgiving dinner, Thu 26 Nov 2026, 2 PM, 14 people (10 adults, 4 kids), Andover. Budget cap unset; no budget statement. No on-hand confirmed; no substitutions. Catalogue-priced: carrots 3 1/2 lb $6.35, 2 generic onions $2.50, 2 oranges $3.00, garlic 1 bulb $1.50; $13.35, not a food cost. Host (DT) estimates separate and unverified: turkey 16 lb (host-confirmed) $14.24, carrots bag $2.90, corn bag $2.99, cranberries 1.5 lb $2.99, two potato bags $2.50 each; six-line sum $28.12; green beans $4.95 only if per can; onion bag fallback, not counted. Potatoes split across two dishes, 10 lb total, 1 lb spare visible; Chef's mash ratio is an assumption. Stuffing split confirmed with no quantity change. Garlic confirmed: 4-5 cloves is one bulb. Ham ~10 lb unpriced; DT's $2.99/lb host-supplied and excluded; not glazed, but plant coating still read. Mustards unpriced; mustard allergen and possible egg; second is Swedish (Slotts or IKEA). Mash side 2 sticks unsalted butter: 6 sticks across menu, pack-vs-sticks unresolved; mash stays 5 lb at 14 covers; cream or whole milk one line. One pumpkin pie for 14, second requested but not priced until DT says. Sweet potato casserole 6 lines unpriced; marshmallows may contain gelatin. Cinnamon unknown by Chef ruling. Pearl onion not generic onion. Orange line contingent on relish. Two ovens confirmed. Brussels sprouts not on menu, not added. Beverages: sparkling water ~4 litres, soda 24 cans half diet, coffee ~15 cups plus decaf, tea ~8 bags (Chef's planning assumption, not sourced); cloudy farm cider 1 gallon is DT's figure (seq 169) replacing the Chef's half-gallon wholesale; fixings milk/cream ~1 pint (no nut milks), sugar, 1 lemon, filters or pods (machine unknown), ice. HARD DIETARY CONSTRAINT: one guest severely allergic to tree nuts and poppy seeds, no cross-contamination. Bread crumbs plain only. DT host-cleared the named branded vanilla ice cream, marshmallows, crispy fried onions and pie shell on prior safe use: host-cleared brand, no substitutes, still unpriced; a shop substitution lapses the clearance and the label matters again.
tasks.last_exchange: DT said 'we'll buy a gallon' (seq 169) and the Chef confirmed the cider line moved. Shopper changed the cider quantity to 1 gallon on both tables and in the draft, recorded as DT's figure replacing the half-gallon, and replied to the Chef. Counts unchanged: 66 lines, 4 catalogue-priced ($13.35), 62 without a catalogue price, six host-estimate lines ($28.12).
